<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#f6f3ed">
  <meta name="description" content="Una ruta 3D interactiva por la Alhambra de Granada: seis paradas, historia y consejos para la visita.">
  <title>Alhambra — Un paseo entre palacios</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      --paper: #f6f3ed;
      --panel: rgba(255, 253, 249, .94);
      --ink: #252b27;
      --muted: #7b7e75;
      --line: #deddd4;
      --accent: #9e3d32;
      --accent-dark: #7d2d25;
      --gold: #bd9562;
      --green: #4e6655;
      --serif: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
      --sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
    body { font-family: var(--sans); color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); overflow: hidden; }
    button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    button { font: inherit; }
    button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(158, 61, 50, .32); outline-offset: 3px; }
    svg { display: block; }

    .app { height: 100dvh; min-height: 580px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .topbar {
      height: 78px; flex: 0 0 78px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 30px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(246, 243, 237, .94);
      position: relative; z-index: 20;
    }
    .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 250px; }
    .brand-mark { width: 38px; height: 38px; color: var(--accent); }
    .brand-name { font: 600 22px/1 var(--serif); letter-spacing: .13em; }
    .brand-place { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .23em; color: var(--muted); }
    .main-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 34px; height: 100%; }
    .nav-button {
      position: relative; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #74786f; padding: 0; height: 100%;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-button:hover { color: var(--accent); }
    .nav-button.active { color: var(--ink); }
    .nav-button.active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); }
    .top-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 20px; min-width: 250px; }

    .guide-button {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #d8d7ce; border-radius: 8px;

    }

    .stop-time { font-size: 9px; color: #8c8f86; padding-right: 2px; }
    .active .stop-time { color: var(--accent); }
    .sidebar-footer { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; gap: 9px; align-items: center; }

    .scene-wrap {
      position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden;
      background: #e9e5dc; border: 1px solid rgba(207, 204, 193, .7); isolation: isolate;
    }
    #scene { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; }
    #scene.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
    .scene-top { position: absolute; top: 21px; left: 23px; right: 21px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 15px; pointer-events: none; }
    .scene-caption { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #6e746a; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; }
